svg.text: Frame NTC as the trip source, 433 MHz fob heartbeat as the output. Mains side is on ladder_coil_circuit.svg, not here.
the isolation barrier for the whole build
clamps to the motor frame, not the winding
measure it — the real value goes in the β equation
the only way out of MANUAL_LOCKOUT
no shared ground with the fob — that is the point
MANDATORY — floating must mean not transmitting
Pins from firmware/include/saw_config.h; ESP32 function warnings from Espressif ESP-IDF. Discrete part art © Uri Shaked, MIT (@wokwi/elements).
